{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Lobito power station''' is a power station in pre-construction in Lobito, Benguela, Angola.
It is also known as Benguela.

==Background==

Angola's "Long Term Plan" for their power sector included various scenarios for developing up to 1200 MW of gas-fired power generation capacity at this power station.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gestoenergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/ANGOLA-POWER-SECTOR-LONG-TERM-VISION.pdf|title=Angola Power Sector Long Term Vision|last=Ministro de Energia e Águas|first=|date=|website=GastoPower|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=Jun 13th, 2022}}</ref> In 2022, it was announced that a consortium of South Korean companies would build a 750 MW gas plant at this location.<ref name='ref_A'>{{cite web |url=https://asian-power.com/project/news/south-korean-consortium-build-750mw-angolan-gas-project |title=South Korean consortium to build 750MW Angolan gas project |date= |website=Asian Power |access-date=January 28, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210602184205/https://asian-power.com/project/news/south-korean-consortium-build-750mw-angolan-gas-project |archive-date=June 2, 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref>
